parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: Because of the large number of matched resources, the backend uses aggregation and does not support pagination. This parameter is reserved. By default, a maximum of 2,000 entries are returned.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: Because of the large number of matched resources, the backend uses aggregation and does not support pagination. This parameter is reserved.

parameters.name: ResourceScope
parameters.description: The resource match scope. This parameter can be empty.
